composition_policy.selection: The fixed source factory evaluator map is the composition; each criterion selects its exact member profile. No automatic substitution between Paddle/EasyOCR.
composition_policy.readiness: Before any decode, authorize and verify all requested criterion member assets/versions; missing member rejects entire request. Unrequested members remain lazy.
composition_policy.enrollment: Operator enrolls each member profile with immutable asset/configuration pins and grants; profile digest covers sorted criterion/member/version/configuration map. All profiles stay unverified until provisioning.
composition_policy.singletons: Existing singleton profile permits only its own criterion type (and metadata if explicitly declared by enrollment); multiple types require this composite profile.
composition_policy.optional_easyocr: Alternative composite with EasyOCR requires separate explicit enrollment through VideoFilterPipeline evaluator mapping; no claim that default factory selects EasyOCR.

Calculate the Shannon information gain of a categorical split in bits.

The child collections must form a complete multiset partition of the parent
labels. Empty child collections are allowed and contribute zero entropy.

    ValueError: If the parent is empty, no child partitions are supplied, or
        the children do not form a complete partition of the parent labels.
